commitments.target: specific builds containing the credential-like string
commitments.detail: Revoking access for specific builds containing the credential-like string to prevent further exposure.
Performing a thorough check across all six repositories to ensure the credential-like string is not present elsewhere.
Notifying customers within 24 hours of the incident to inform them of the potential risk and actions taken.
Retaining all evidence related to this incident for at least 90 days for review and audit purposes.
Obtaining signoff from both internal and external compliance teams to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.
